description: Path-1 derivation of ρ_K^LO via Markov multiplicativity for disjoint braids (Wenzl 1988 Theorem 5). Verifies the Wenzl branching identity numerically for H_6 ↓ H_3 × H_3 to machine precision: χ^λ(β_p ⊗ β_n) = Σ c^λ_{μν} χ^μ(β_p) χ^ν(β_n). Combined with the Plancherel-weight branching rule (standard rep-theory), this gives tr_M(β_p ⊗ β_n) = tr_M(β_p) · tr_M(β_n) → ρ_K^free is categorically derived. For the bound deuteron, the interface ratio |tr_M(β_D)|/(|tr_M(β_p)|·|tr_M(β_n)|) ≈ 0.939 quantifies the A^λ_{μν}(I) interface contribution per refined Sub-lemma 2.1 (`prop:hecke-branching-trace-decomposition`).
conclusion: Markov multiplicativity for disjoint p+n is a categorical consequence of Wenzl 1988 Theorem 5, verified numerically. ρ_K^LO is therefore CATEGORICALLY DERIVED, not an empirical ansatz. The deviation in the bound atomic case is the operator-valued A^λ_{μν}(I) interface from the refined Sub-lemma 2.1.
